blurb: Guests can customize their visit to include various attractions such as trampoline jumping, Airtrack Basketball, and arcade games. The facility includes an in-house restaurant called Krave where guests can create their own food items or choose from signature menu items. Various passes and add-ons are available to tailor the experience.
